name: mnemoscope
description: Predictive context-rot scoring, Ed25519-signed local write journal, and hierarchical tiering for LLM agents on Markdown vaults. 100% local; ships an MCP server and an Obsidian plugin.

tools.name: predict_rot
tools.description: Predictive context-rot risk score for a vault, with factor breakdown and top-risk notes.

tools.name: get_tiered_read
tools.description: Working/episodic/semantic split of a vault for compacted context injection.

tools.name: record_journal
tools.description: Append a signed, hash-chained entry to the local journal of agent operations.

tools.name: read_journal
tools.description: Replay journal entries, optionally filtered by session.
